verdict.rationale: Trivy is an official CLI ([trivy-probe-5]) run non-interactively with commands like `trivy image` and `trivy k8s --report summary cluster`, and it is also distributed as a Docker image ([trivy-docs-17], [trivy-gh-1], [trivy-gh-2]). Independent users say it is 'super easy to integrate in every ci/cd pipeline', 'very easy to write automation around', and run it only in CI ([trivy-comm-14], [trivy-comm-11], [trivy-comm-12]). missing for 10: first-party CI integration documentation, evidence of machine-readable output formats (e.g. JSON) and exit-code controls for pipeline gating.
